text: micchādiṭṭhi .pe. micchāsamādhīti . [57] pāṭaliputtanidānaṃ .pe. brahmacariyaṃ brahmacariyanti āvuso ānanda vuccati katamaṃ nu kho āvuso brahmacariyaṃ katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti . sādhu sādhu kho 1 āvuso bhadda bhaddako kho te āvuso bhadda ummaṅgo bhaddakaṃ paṭibhāṇaṃ kalyāṇī paripucchā evaṃ hi tvaṃ āvuso bhadda pucchasi brahmacariyaṃ brahmacariyanti āvuso ānanda vuccati katamaṃ nu kho āvuso brahmacariyaṃ katamaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti . evamāvusoti . ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṃ . seyyathīdaṃ . sammādiṭṭhi .pe. sammāsamādhi . yo kho āvuso rāgakkhayo
